numeric.question: Compute the total volume passing through any detected cycle; compare to KYC declared monthly volume.
numeric.answer: $112,103.38, about 5.5% of the declared monthly volume
numeric.calculation:
1. Identify transactions that form a cycle. The only pair that creates a clear cycle is the outbound wire to AM Logistics LLC on 2026-04-08 (56051.69 USD) and the returned wire to the same counterparty on 2026-04-10 (56051.69 USD).
2. Sum the amounts flowing in the cycle: 56051.69 + 56051.69 = 112,103.38 USD.
3. Compare to the KYC declared monthly volume of 2,041,684 USD.
4. Ratio = 112,103.38 / 2,041,684 ≈ 0.0549, i.e., roughly 5.5% of the declared volume.
